description: This file defines the IMiracastPlayer interface for Miracast playback control, including states, reason codes, device parameters, video rectangle, result handling, environment arguments, and notifications within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IMiracastPlayer
classes.description: Interface for Miracast playback control with methods for registration, play, stop, set video rectangle, environment configuration, and notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for Miracast player events.

methods.name: PlayRequest
methods.description: Start Miracast playback with device parameters and video rectangle.

methods.name: StopRequest
methods.description: Stop Miracast playback for a specified client.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Configure the video rectangle for playback.
